name: devopsfoundry
description: Put apps and static sites on AWS with DevOpsFoundry, a Terraform toolkit: container services on ECS Fargate behind HTTPS with optional Postgres, Redis and SES email, or S3 and CloudFront sites, with DNS and certificates. A skill for deploying and operating with its bin/ scripts, and a hook that asks before steps that skip their plan approval.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy apps and sites to AWS with DevOpsFoundry's Terraform scripts
